written_after: reading the outputs of notebooks 03 and 04 (this addendum is post-results and is reported as such)
problems_found: Day-block bootstrap percentile intervals for correlation-type statistics lie below the point estimates in most years (e.g. N2 2011: r=0.921, interval 0.782-0.893): resampling adds a second layer of count noise that attenuates correlations. The intervals and the addendum-1 flag built on them are biased and are not used for inference.

Cochran Q / I2 on pseudo-count log ratios is dominated by strong-deficit pairs with zero or one observed co-occurrence, whose bootstrap variance is near zero and whose log ratio moves with E through the 0.5 pseudo-count (e.g. static demonstration-arson, Q=323 on 6 df). It is kept in the SI with this caveat but not used for inference.

replacement_method.per_year_departure: Quasi-Poisson F ratio. Between: Pearson X2 of year t against mu_ht = E_ht * a_t * b_h(-t), where b(-t) is the constant-structure (M1) pair effect estimated from all other years and a_t matches year t's total; cells E_ht >= 2 within the primary eligible set; df_t = cells - 1. Within: the same cells, year t's protest days split at random into two halves (50 splits, seed 20261108), Pearson X2 of the 2 x cells table against a common within-year structure (IPF), df = cells with positive year total - 1; dispersion = mean X2 / df. F_t = (X2_between/df_t) / dispersion_t; p from F(df_t, df_within). Share of departure beyond noise = 1 - 1/F_t.
replacement_method.global: Pooled F = (sum X2_between / sum df) / (sum X2_within / sum df_within).
replacement_method.unidiff_test: Quasi-likelihood F for M1 vs M2 with the pooled within-year dispersion.
replacement_method.decomposition_noise_floor: In addition to the frozen permutation floor, a dispersion floor: expected noise deviance/X2 = pooled within-year dispersion x residual df.
replacement_method.correlation_uncertainty: Correlations, ceilings and disattenuated ratios are reported as descriptive point estimates; their bootstrap percentile intervals are reported in the SI with the attenuation caveat.
